attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DHCP server for the private network it shares with node2/node3 (10.50.50.0/24 via eth1, pool .100-.200), and configured node2/node3 (CentOS Stream 10) to obtain their private-network address via DHCP (NetworkManager ipv4.method=auto) instead of a static assignment. Implemented entirely via an Ansible playbook run from node4 (pre-provisioned control node). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all 4 managed nodes.
